vb_textbox.text: there will be two pairs of gnomes, of the pairs, the gnomes will be different colors. in my game the pairs were purple/brown, and red/green(but the colors might be different in your game). these colors will not change through out the game, so remember them quickly.in each pair, one of the gnomes is capable of giving zero points, while the other isn't.in my game, the purple and red gnomes were capable of giving zero points.pick the gnomes that don't give 0 points through out the entire game, and you'll be set. pay attention, since the gnomes can be in different orders each round(so don't look away from the screen), and if you don't react in time, you'll lose that round(so getting 0 points for that round).notes:in my game, the brown and green gnome were basically the same, and the same goes for red/purple. brown/green gnomes had a forest with purple trees and a yellow basket, while red/purple had a forest with brown trees and a red basket. good luck.
